title: Drive Luxury exact database reuse proposal
status: FINAL PROPOSED DESIGN; CLIENT-REPORTED CHANGES UNVERIFIED; NO DEPLOYMENT EXECUTED
scope: All features in supplied Client Agent and Chauffeur backend; preserve existing API types and IDs; maintain admin ownership.
assumptions: All supplied backend features remain enabled, including agent isolation and approval workflows.
DBA accepts narrowly scoped additive fields and indexes in existing tables.
Admin team integrates new inquiry review fields and private file access.
Public numeric IDs and historical references are migrated with collision checks; original UUID primary keys are preserved.
Internal chauffeur outlays are separate from billable customer costs until client accounting confirms a shared classification.
The 26 is a concrete target design, not a proven theoretical minimum or an applied database state.
DBA applies reviewed migration SQL and records versions in the deployment record; the Node migration runner and app_schema_migrations are not deployed.

client_tables_newly_reused.contacts: Canonical VIP and concierge inquiry, using existing airport, flight, passenger, date and request fields; add ownership and review state.
client_tables_newly_reused.notifications: Canonical inbox, with a numeric mobile ID and original UUID preserved.
client_tables_newly_reused.password_resets: Shared reset broker; compatible token hash verification, atomic expiry and consumption.
client_tables_newly_reused.reservation_messages: Canonical text and document messages; preserve mobile message ID.
client_tables_newly_reused.reservation_message_recipients: Recipient delivery and read state for both admin and mobile messages.
client_tables_newly_reused.reservation_message_attachments: Canonical chat attachments linked to a managed document.
client_tables_newly_reused.file_managers: Canonical managed document identity and admin file record; add private access and expiry metadata.
client_tables_newly_reused.media_files: Reuse existing full storage path, disk, MIME type and byte size instead of duplicating these fields.
client_tables_newly_reused.reservation_files: Link managed documents to reservations and trip legs.
client_tables_newly_reused.customer_files: Link managed customer documents to the client profile.
client_tables_newly_reused.driver_files: Link managed chauffeur documents to the driver profile.
client_tables_newly_reused.reservation_flight_numbers: Reuse native leg-level flight number and terminal information.
client_tables_newly_reused.reservation_statuses: Resolve admin trip status IDs and slugs to the existing API lifecycle values.
client_tables_newly_reused.vehicle_original_cities: Native home-city mapping for collection fees; distinct from vehicle service coverage.
client_tables_newly_reused.discount_coupons: Native coupon configuration, validity, amount/type and usage cap.
client_tables_newly_reused.reservation_discount_coupons: Native redeemed coupon and reservation discount summary.

client_merge_mapping.reason: Translate website service records into existing mobile catalog fields.
Mobile provenance and quote reference accompany the same reservation. Derive service code from native service_type and use native currency and user_id.
Leg attributes accompany the same trip; use the dedicated client flight table for flight number.
Same business assignment, with pickup/dropoff role and public ID compatibility.
Shared reservation timeline and driver status history; populate native trip_status_id correctly.
One canonical message history accessible to the client admin and mobile app.
One canonical inbox; retain Expo delivery tables and preserve numeric API IDs.
Reuse file identities and physical object metadata; add private access and expiry fields only where absent.
Use the client broker record and preserve the token-only mobile request format through a lookup hash.
Existing contacts already includes meet-and-greet flight and passenger fields; add review and ownership state.
Service inquiry content belongs in the client inquiry queue; retain category and extra details under metadata.mobile.

additional_merge_mapping.reason: Already redirected in runtime; do not create both incident stores.
Retain original expense IDs in the restored expense table and use its native AUTO_INCREMENT. No independent expense allocator is then needed.

retained_additional_tables.reason: Revocable mobile refresh sessions. Laravel sessions and trusted-device tokens have different purposes.
retained_additional_tables.proposed_definition:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS app_refresh_tokens (
  id CHAR(36) NOT NULL,
  user_id INT UNSIGNED NOT NULL,
  token_hash CHAR(64) NOT NULL,
  device_id VARCHAR(191) NULL,
  expires_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
  revoked_at TIMESTAMP NULL,
  created_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  PRIMARY KEY (id),
  UNIQUE KEY uq_app_refresh_tokens_hash (token_hash),
  KEY idx_app_refresh_tokens_user (user_id,expires_at),
  CONSTRAINT fk_app_refresh_tokens_user FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci;

retained_additional_tables.reason: Google provider subject linked to a client user. Email alone does not safely establish provider identity.
retained_additional_tables.proposed_definition:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS app_user_oauth_accounts (
  id BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  user_id INT UNSIGNED NOT NULL,
  provider VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,
  provider_subject VARCHAR(191) NOT NULL,
  provider_email VARCHAR(191) NOT NULL,
  created_at TIMESTAMP NULL,
  updated_at TIMESTAMP NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (id),
  UNIQUE KEY uq_app_oauth_provider_subject (provider,provider_subject),
  UNIQUE KEY uq_app_oauth_user_provider (user_id,provider),
  KEY idx_app_oauth_provider_email (provider,provider_email),
  CONSTRAINT fk_app_oauth_user FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci;

retained_additional_tables.reason: Agent account activation, invitation expiry, acceptance and resend tracking. Magic login is a different action.
retained_additional_tables.proposed_definition:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS app_account_invitations (
  id BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  user_id INT UNSIGNED NOT NULL,
  email VARCHAR(191) NOT NULL,
  role TINYINT NOT NULL,
  token_hash CHAR(64) NOT NULL,
  expires_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
  accepted_at TIMESTAMP NULL,
  last_sent_at TIMESTAMP NULL,
  send_count INT UNSIGNED NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  created_by_user_id INT UNSIGNED NOT NULL,
  created_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  PRIMARY KEY (id),
  UNIQUE KEY uq_app_account_invitation_token (token_hash),
  KEY idx_app_account_invitation_user (user_id),
  KEY idx_app_account_invitation_pending (user_id,accepted_at,expires_at),
  CONSTRAINT fk_app_account_invitation_user FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  CONSTRAINT fk_app_account_invitation_creator FOREIGN KEY (created_by_user_id) REFERENCES users(id)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci;

retained_additional_tables.reason: Expo token, device identity, platform, app version and last seen time. Trusted devices are authentication records.
retained_additional_tables.proposed_definition:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS app_user_devices (
  id BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  user_id INT UNSIGNED NOT NULL,
  device_id VARCHAR(191) NOT NULL,
  platform ENUM('IOS','ANDROID','WEB') NOT NULL,
  push_token VARCHAR(512) NULL,
  app_version VARCHAR(32) NULL,
  last_seen_at TIMESTAMP NULL,
  created_at TIMESTAMP NULL,
  updated_at TIMESTAMP NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (id),
  UNIQUE KEY uq_app_user_devices_device (device_id),
  UNIQUE KEY uq_app_user_devices_push (push_token),

  CONSTRAINT fk_app_user_devices_user FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci;

retained_additional_tables.reason: Durable push outbox with retries and delivery state. Inbox remains in client notifications.
retained_additional_tables.proposed_definition:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS app_push_delivery_jobs (
  id BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  notification_id BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL,
  user_id INT UNSIGNED NOT NULL,
  status ENUM('PENDING','PROCESSING','RETRY','SENT','SKIPPED','FAILED') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'PENDING',
  attempts INT UNSIGNED NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  next_attempt_at DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  lock_token VARCHAR(36) NULL,
  locked_until DATETIME NULL,
  last_error VARCHAR(120) NULL,
  created_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  updated_at TIMESTAMP NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (id),
  UNIQUE KEY uq_app_push_job_notification (notification_id),
  KEY idx_app_push_job_due (status,next_attempt_at,locked_until),
  CONSTRAINT fk_app_push_job_notification FOREIGN KEY (notification_id) REFERENCES notifications(mobile_notification_id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  CONSTRAINT fk_app_push_job_user FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci;

retained_additional_tables.reason: Per-device Expo ticket and receipt state; one notification can have multiple deliveries.
retained_additional_tables.proposed_definition:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS app_push_delivery_tickets (
  id BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  job_id BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL,
  user_id INT UNSIGNED NOT NULL,
  device_id VARCHAR(191) NOT NULL,
  push_token_hash CHAR(64) NOT NULL,
  receipt_id VARCHAR(191) NOT NULL,
  status ENUM('PENDING','DELIVERED','FAILED','EXPIRED') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'PENDING',
  provider_error VARCHAR(120) NULL,
  checked_at TIMESTAMP NULL,
  created_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  PRIMARY KEY (id),
  UNIQUE KEY uq_app_push_ticket_receipt (receipt_id),
  KEY idx_app_push_ticket_pending (status,created_at),
  CONSTRAINT fk_app_push_ticket_job FOREIGN KEY (job_id) REFERENCES app_push_delivery_jobs(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  CONSTRAINT fk_app_push_ticket_user FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci;

retained_additional_tables.reason: Incomplete checkout state, revision and expiry. Not a confirmed reservation or an issued sales offer.
retained_additional_tables.proposed_definition:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS app_booking_drafts (
  id BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  created_by_user_id INT UNSIGNED NOT NULL,
  created_by_agent_id INT UNSIGNED NULL,
  customer_id INT UNSIGNED NOT NULL,
  agency_id INT UNSIGNED NULL,
  service_code VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL,
  status ENUM('DRAFT','READY','QUOTED','CHECKED_OUT','EXPIRED','ABANDONED') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'DRAFT',
  details JSON NOT NULL,
  revision INT UNSIGNED NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
  quote_snapshot_id BIGINT UNSIGNED NULL,
  reservation_id INT UNSIGNED NULL,
  expires_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
  created_at TIMESTAMP NULL,
  updated_at TIMESTAMP NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (id),
  KEY idx_app_booking_drafts_user_status (created_by_user_id,status),
  KEY idx_app_booking_drafts_customer (customer_id),
  KEY idx_app_booking_drafts_expiry (expires_at,status),
  CONSTRAINT fk_app_booking_drafts_user FOREIGN KEY (created_by_user_id) REFERENCES users(id),
  CONSTRAINT fk_app_booking_drafts_agent FOREIGN KEY (created_by_agent_id) REFERENCES agents(id),
  CONSTRAINT fk_app_booking_drafts_customer FOREIGN KEY (customer_id) REFERENCES customers(id),
  CONSTRAINT fk_app_booking_drafts_agency FOREIGN KEY (agency_id) REFERENCES agencies(id),
  CONSTRAINT fk_app_booking_drafts_reservation FOREIGN KEY (reservation_id) REFERENCES reservations(id)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci;

retained_additional_tables.reason: Immutable quoted amount and inputs bound to a draft revision and validity time.
retained_additional_tables.proposed_definition:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS app_quote_snapshots (
  id BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  draft_id BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL,
  draft_revision INT UNSIGNED NOT NULL,
  request_hash CHAR(64) NOT NULL,
  currency CHAR(3) NOT NULL,
  total_amount DECIMAL(12,2) NOT NULL,
  quote_data JSON NOT NULL,
  valid_until TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
  created_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  PRIMARY KEY (id),
  KEY idx_app_quote_draft (draft_id,valid_until),
  CONSTRAINT fk_app_quote_draft FOREIGN KEY (draft_id) REFERENCES app_booking_drafts(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci;

retained_additional_tables.reason: Prevents duplicate checkout on retries and returns the original response.
retained_additional_tables.proposed_definition:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS app_idempotency_keys (
  id BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  user_id INT UNSIGNED NOT NULL,
  scope VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL,
  idempotency_key VARCHAR(191) NOT NULL,
  request_hash CHAR(64) NOT NULL,
  response_status INT NOT NULL,
  response_body JSON NOT NULL,
  expires_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
  created_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  PRIMARY KEY (id),
  UNIQUE KEY uq_app_idempotency_user_scope_key (user_id,scope,idempotency_key),
  KEY idx_app_idempotency_expiry (expires_at),
  CONSTRAINT fk_app_idempotency_user FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci;

retained_additional_tables.reason: Stripe attempt and intent state, provider reference, retry metadata and refund reference. Client reservation_payments owns paid money.
retained_additional_tables.proposed_definition:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS app_payment_transactions (
  id BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  reservation_id INT UNSIGNED NOT NULL,
  user_id INT UNSIGNED NOT NULL,
  provider VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL,
  provider_reference VARCHAR(191) NULL,
  amount DECIMAL(12,2) NOT NULL,
  currency CHAR(3) NOT NULL,
  status VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL,
  idempotency_key VARCHAR(191) NULL,
  provider_payload JSON NULL,

  created_at TIMESTAMP NULL,
  updated_at TIMESTAMP NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (id),
  UNIQUE KEY uq_app_payment_provider_ref (provider,provider_reference),
  KEY idx_app_payment_reservation (reservation_id,status),
  CONSTRAINT fk_app_payment_reservation FOREIGN KEY (reservation_id) REFERENCES reservations(id),
  CONSTRAINT fk_app_payment_user FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES users(id)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci;

retained_additional_tables.reason: Provider event deduplication and audit so repeated webhooks cannot post payment twice.
retained_additional_tables.proposed_definition:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS app_payment_webhook_events (
  id BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  provider VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL,
  provider_event_id VARCHAR(191) NOT NULL,
  payload JSON NOT NULL,
  received_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (id),
  UNIQUE KEY uq_app_payment_webhook_event (provider,provider_event_id)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci;

retained_additional_tables.reason: Individual agent roster, active membership, preferences and notes. customers.agency_id identifies an agency, not a particular agent.
retained_additional_tables.proposed_definition:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS app_agent_customer_assignments (
  id BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  agent_id INT UNSIGNED NOT NULL,
  customer_id INT UNSIGNED NOT NULL,
  agency_id INT UNSIGNED NOT NULL,
  status ENUM('ACTIVE','INACTIVE') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'ACTIVE',
  preferences JSON NULL,

  assigned_by_user_id INT UNSIGNED NOT NULL,

  updated_at TIMESTAMP NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (id),

  KEY idx_app_agent_customer_customer (customer_id,status),
  KEY idx_app_agent_customer_agency (agency_id,status),
  CONSTRAINT fk_app_agent_customer_agent FOREIGN KEY (agent_id) REFERENCES agents(id),
  CONSTRAINT fk_app_agent_customer_customer FOREIGN KEY (customer_id) REFERENCES customers(id),
  CONSTRAINT fk_app_agent_customer_agency FOREIGN KEY (agency_id) REFERENCES agencies(id),
  CONSTRAINT fk_app_agent_customer_assigner FOREIGN KEY (assigned_by_user_id) REFERENCES users(id)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci;

retained_additional_tables.reason: Pending requested change, prior lifecycle, requested values, approver and resolution. A reservation row stores the accepted booking.
retained_additional_tables.proposed_definition:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS app_booking_change_requests (
  id BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  reservation_id INT UNSIGNED NOT NULL,
  requested_by_user_id INT UNSIGNED NOT NULL,
  status VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'PENDING',
  previous_lifecycle_status VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL,
  reason TEXT NOT NULL,
  requested_changes JSON NOT NULL,
  resolution_note TEXT NULL,
  resolved_by_user_id INT UNSIGNED NULL,
  resolved_at TIMESTAMP NULL,
  created_at TIMESTAMP NULL,
  updated_at TIMESTAMP NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (id),
  KEY idx_app_change_request_reservation (reservation_id,status),
  CONSTRAINT fk_app_change_request_reservation FOREIGN KEY (reservation_id) REFERENCES reservations(id),
  CONSTRAINT fk_app_change_request_requester FOREIGN KEY (requested_by_user_id) REFERENCES users(id),
  CONSTRAINT fk_app_change_request_resolver FOREIGN KEY (resolved_by_user_id) REFERENCES users(id)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci;

retained_additional_tables.reason: Pending cancellation and refund approval state, reason, reviewer and resolution; distinct from an already cancelled booking.
retained_additional_tables.proposed_definition:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS app_booking_cancellation_requests (
  id BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  reservation_id INT UNSIGNED NOT NULL,
  requested_by_user_id INT UNSIGNED NOT NULL,
  status VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'PENDING',
  previous_lifecycle_status VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL,
  reason TEXT NOT NULL,
  resolution_note TEXT NULL,
  resolved_by_user_id INT UNSIGNED NULL,
  resolved_at TIMESTAMP NULL,
  created_at TIMESTAMP NULL,
  updated_at TIMESTAMP NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (id),

  CONSTRAINT fk_app_cancel_request_reservation FOREIGN KEY (reservation_id) REFERENCES reservations(id),
  CONSTRAINT fk_app_cancel_request_requester FOREIGN KEY (requested_by_user_id) REFERENCES users(id),
  CONSTRAINT fk_app_cancel_request_resolver FOREIGN KEY (resolved_by_user_id) REFERENCES users(id)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci;

retained_additional_tables.reason: Stable existing conversation ID and open or closed state per reservation. Message content moves to client message tables.
retained_additional_tables.proposed_definition:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS app_conversations (
  id BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  reservation_id INT UNSIGNED NOT NULL,
  status ENUM('ACTIVE','CLOSED') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'ACTIVE',
  created_at TIMESTAMP NULL,
  updated_at TIMESTAMP NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (id),
  UNIQUE KEY uq_app_conversation_reservation (reservation_id),
  CONSTRAINT fk_app_conversation_reservation FOREIGN KEY (reservation_id) REFERENCES reservations(id)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci;

retained_additional_tables.reason: Membership, role, join and leave boundaries needed before any message exists. Existing recipients are per-message, not conversation membership.
retained_additional_tables.proposed_definition:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS app_conversation_participants (
  id BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  conversation_id BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL,
  user_id INT UNSIGNED NOT NULL,
  participant_role VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL,
  joined_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
  left_at TIMESTAMP NULL,
  last_read_at TIMESTAMP NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (id),
  UNIQUE KEY uq_app_conversation_participant (conversation_id,user_id),
  KEY idx_app_conversation_participant_user (user_id,left_at),
  CONSTRAINT fk_app_conversation_participant_conversation FOREIGN KEY (conversation_id) REFERENCES app_conversations(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,

retained_additional_tables.reason: Assignment GPS samples with time, heading and speed. A current vehicle location field is not a trip location history.
retained_additional_tables.proposed_definition:

  id BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  assignment_id BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL,
  driver_id INT UNSIGNED NOT NULL,
  latitude DECIMAL(10,7) NOT NULL,

) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci;

retained_additional_tables.reason: Delay, safety, passenger and service issues with resolution. Physical damage can link to reservation_vehicle_damages.
retained_additional_tables.proposed_definition:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS reservation_service_incidents (
  id BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  assignment_id BIGINT UNSIGNED NULL,
  reservation_id INT UNSIGNED NOT NULL,
  reported_by_user_id INT UNSIGNED NOT NULL,
  type VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL,
  severity VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL,
  description TEXT NOT NULL,
  latitude DECIMAL(10,7) NULL,
  longitude DECIMAL(10,7) NULL,
  document_ids JSON NULL,
  status VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'OPEN',
  resolution_note TEXT NULL,
  resolved_by_user_id INT UNSIGNED NULL,
  reported_at DATETIME NOT NULL,
  resolved_at TIMESTAMP NULL,
  vehicle_damage_id BIGINT UNSIGNED NULL,
  created_at TIMESTAMP NULL,
  updated_at TIMESTAMP NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (id),
  KEY idx_rsi_reservation_status (reservation_id,status),
  KEY idx_rsi_assignment (assignment_id),
  KEY idx_rsi_vehicle_damage (vehicle_damage_id),
  CONSTRAINT fk_rsi_assignment FOREIGN KEY (assignment_id)
    REFERENCES app_mobile_assignment_ids (id),
  CONSTRAINT fk_rsi_reservation FOREIGN KEY (reservation_id)
    REFERENCES reservations (id),
  CONSTRAINT fk_rsi_reporter FOREIGN KEY (reported_by_user_id)
    REFERENCES users (id),
  CONSTRAINT fk_rsi_resolver FOREIGN KEY (resolved_by_user_id)
    REFERENCES users (id),
  CONSTRAINT fk_rsi_damage FOREIGN KEY (vehicle_damage_id)
    REFERENCES reservation_vehicle_damages (id)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci;

retained_additional_tables.reason: Provider call session, initiator, recipient role, status and expiry.
retained_additional_tables.proposed_definition:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS app_masked_calls (
  id BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  reservation_id INT UNSIGNED NOT NULL,
  initiator_user_id INT UNSIGNED NOT NULL,
  recipient_role VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL,
  provider VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL,
  provider_reference VARCHAR(191) NULL,
  status VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL,
  expires_at TIMESTAMP NULL,
  created_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  PRIMARY KEY (id),
  KEY idx_app_masked_call_reservation (reservation_id,created_at),
  CONSTRAINT fk_app_masked_call_reservation FOREIGN KEY (reservation_id) REFERENCES reservations(id),
  CONSTRAINT fk_app_masked_call_initiator FOREIGN KEY (initiator_user_id) REFERENCES users(id)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci;

retained_additional_tables.reason: Masked number routing and the two parties for a call session.
retained_additional_tables.proposed_definition:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS app_telnyx_call_routes (
  masked_call_id BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL,
  caller_phone VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL,
  recipient_phone VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL,
  inbound_call_id VARCHAR(191) NULL,
  outbound_call_id VARCHAR(191) NULL,
  created_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  PRIMARY KEY (masked_call_id),
  UNIQUE KEY uq_telnyx_inbound_call_id (inbound_call_id),
  UNIQUE KEY uq_telnyx_outbound_call_id (outbound_call_id),
  KEY idx_telnyx_caller_phone (caller_phone),
  CONSTRAINT fk_telnyx_masked_call FOREIGN KEY (masked_call_id) REFERENCES app_masked_calls(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci;

retained_additional_tables.reason: Telnyx event deduplication and processing audit.
Stable public IDs and role-specific state linked to native pickup and drop-off assignments. One native reservation_drivers row can hold two distinct roles.
retained_additional_tables.proposed_definition:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `app_mobile_assignment_ids` (
  `id` BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  reservation_driver_id INT UNSIGNED NULL,
  assignment_role VARCHAR(12) NULL,
  driver_id INT UNSIGNED NULL,
  assignment_status VARCHAR(40) NULL,
  current_slot TINYINT UNSIGNED NULL,
  scheduled_start_at DATETIME NULL,
  scheduled_end_at DATETIME NULL,
  acknowledged_at TIMESTAMP NULL,
  declined_at TIMESTAMP NULL,
  decline_reason TEXT NULL,
  started_at TIMESTAMP NULL,
  completed_at TIMESTAMP NULL,
  assigned_by_user_id INT UNSIGNED NULL,
  created_at TIMESTAMP NULL,
  updated_at TIMESTAMP NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY uq_app_mobile_assignment_current_role (reservation_driver_id,assignment_role,current_slot),
  KEY idx_app_mobile_assignment_driver_schedule (driver_id,scheduled_start_at,scheduled_end_at),
  KEY idx_app_mobile_assignment_row_role_history (reservation_driver_id,assignment_role,id)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci;

retained_additional_tables.reason: Preserve existing mobile event IDs without collision with unrelated client audit-log IDs.
Separate mobile request and response audit required by the client; distinct from shared business status history.
retained_additional_tables.proposed_definition:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS app_api_request_logs (
  id BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  request_id CHAR(36) NOT NULL,
  method VARCHAR(10) NOT NULL,
  request_path VARCHAR(512) NOT NULL,
  access_line VARCHAR(800) NOT NULL,
  http_status SMALLINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL,
  duration_ms DECIMAL(12,3) NOT NULL,
  request_query JSON NULL,
  request_body JSON NULL,
  response_body JSON NULL,
  actor_user_id BIGINT UNSIGNED NULL,
  actor_role SMALLINT NULL,
  client_ip VARCHAR(45) NULL,
  user_agent VARCHAR(255) NULL,
  response_content_type VARCHAR(120) NULL,
  response_bytes BIGINT UNSIGNED NULL,
  error_code VARCHAR(120) NULL,
  created_at DATETIME(3) NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3),
  PRIMARY KEY (id),
  UNIQUE KEY uq_api_audit_request_id (request_id),
  KEY idx_api_audit_created_at (created_at),
  KEY idx_api_audit_actor (actor_user_id, created_at),
  KEY idx_api_audit_http (http_status, created_at)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci;

retained_additional_tables.reason: Derived current/future occupancy claims for atomic cross-application vehicle locking; native tables remain authoritative
retained_additional_tables.proposed_definition:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS app_vehicle_booking_locks (
 source_kind VARCHAR(8) NOT NULL,
 source_id BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL,
 vehicle_id INT UNSIGNED NOT NULL,
 reservation_id BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
 reserved_start DATE NOT NULL,
 reserved_end DATE NOT NULL,
 parent_active TINYINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
 PRIMARY KEY (source_kind,source_id),
 KEY idx_mobile_booking_lock_vehicle_window (vehicle_id,parent_active,reserved_start,reserved_end),
 KEY idx_mobile_booking_lock_reservation (reservation_id,vehicle_id)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci

do_not_add_detail.reservation_other_costs: All 13 mobile_* expense fields; restored internal expense table holds these records.

verification: Implemented in release candidate. Disposable MySQL import and test evidence are in docs/PRODUCTION_VERIFICATION.md. Hosted client rows and original Laravel UI remain unverified.

client_reported_baseline.evidence: User states the three ID tables, 51 columns and 11 indexes were added. The supplied text is an expected-schema SELECT, not its results. No live DB connection, SHOW CREATE TABLE or data rows were supplied.
client_reported_baseline.verification_status: No reported item verified in live schema; original 165-table archive predates these changes and cannot prove their application.
client_reported_baseline.index_caution: Reported index names alone do not prove uniqueness, column order, or types. The old idx_reservations_mobile_status uses service_code, while the target adds a separate differently named index on lifecycle_status and native service_type.

tables_to_add.reason: Revocable mobile refresh sessions. Laravel sessions and trusted-device tokens have different purposes.
tables_to_add.proposed_definition:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS app_refresh_tokens (
  id CHAR(36) NOT NULL,
  user_id INT UNSIGNED NOT NULL,
  token_hash CHAR(64) NOT NULL,
  device_id VARCHAR(191) NULL,
  expires_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
  revoked_at TIMESTAMP NULL,
  created_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  PRIMARY KEY (id),
  UNIQUE KEY uq_app_refresh_tokens_hash (token_hash),
  KEY idx_app_refresh_tokens_user (user_id,expires_at),
  CONSTRAINT fk_app_refresh_tokens_user FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci;

tables_to_add.reason: Google provider subject linked to a client user. Email alone does not safely establish provider identity.
tables_to_add.proposed_definition:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS app_user_oauth_accounts (
  id BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  user_id INT UNSIGNED NOT NULL,
  provider VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,
  provider_subject VARCHAR(191) NOT NULL,
  provider_email VARCHAR(191) NOT NULL,
  created_at TIMESTAMP NULL,
  updated_at TIMESTAMP NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (id),
  UNIQUE KEY uq_app_oauth_provider_subject (provider,provider_subject),
  UNIQUE KEY uq_app_oauth_user_provider (user_id,provider),
  KEY idx_app_oauth_provider_email (provider,provider_email),
  CONSTRAINT fk_app_oauth_user FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci;

tables_to_add.reason: Agent account activation, invitation expiry, acceptance and resend tracking. Magic login is a different action.
tables_to_add.proposed_definition:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS app_account_invitations (
  id BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  user_id INT UNSIGNED NOT NULL,
  email VARCHAR(191) NOT NULL,
  role TINYINT NOT NULL,
  token_hash CHAR(64) NOT NULL,
  expires_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
  accepted_at TIMESTAMP NULL,
  last_sent_at TIMESTAMP NULL,
  send_count INT UNSIGNED NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  created_by_user_id INT UNSIGNED NOT NULL,
  created_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  PRIMARY KEY (id),
  UNIQUE KEY uq_app_account_invitation_token (token_hash),
  KEY idx_app_account_invitation_user (user_id),
  KEY idx_app_account_invitation_pending (user_id,accepted_at,expires_at),
  CONSTRAINT fk_app_account_invitation_user FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  CONSTRAINT fk_app_account_invitation_creator FOREIGN KEY (created_by_user_id) REFERENCES users(id)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci;

tables_to_add.reason: Expo token, device identity, platform, app version and last seen time. Trusted devices are authentication records.
tables_to_add.proposed_definition:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS app_user_devices (
  id BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  user_id INT UNSIGNED NOT NULL,
  device_id VARCHAR(191) NOT NULL,
  platform ENUM('IOS','ANDROID','WEB') NOT NULL,
  push_token VARCHAR(512) NULL,
  app_version VARCHAR(32) NULL,
  last_seen_at TIMESTAMP NULL,
  created_at TIMESTAMP NULL,
  updated_at TIMESTAMP NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (id),
  UNIQUE KEY uq_app_user_devices_device (device_id),
  UNIQUE KEY uq_app_user_devices_push (push_token),
  KEY idx_app_user_devices_user (user_id),
  CONSTRAINT fk_app_user_devices_user FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci;

tables_to_add.reason: Durable push outbox with retries and delivery state. Inbox remains in client notifications.
tables_to_add.proposed_definition:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS app_push_delivery_jobs (
  id BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  notification_id BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL,
  user_id INT UNSIGNED NOT NULL,
  status ENUM('PENDING','PROCESSING','RETRY','SENT','SKIPPED','FAILED') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'PENDING',
  attempts INT UNSIGNED NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  next_attempt_at DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  lock_token VARCHAR(36) NULL,
  locked_until DATETIME NULL,
  last_error VARCHAR(120) NULL,
  created_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  updated_at TIMESTAMP NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (id),
  UNIQUE KEY uq_app_push_job_notification (notification_id),
  KEY idx_app_push_job_due (status,next_attempt_at,locked_until),
  CONSTRAINT fk_app_push_job_notification FOREIGN KEY (notification_id) REFERENCES notifications(mobile_notification_id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  CONSTRAINT fk_app_push_job_user FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci;

tables_to_add.reason: Per-device Expo ticket and receipt state; one notification can have multiple deliveries.
tables_to_add.proposed_definition:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS app_push_delivery_tickets (
  id BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  job_id BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL,
  user_id INT UNSIGNED NOT NULL,
  device_id VARCHAR(191) NOT NULL,
  push_token_hash CHAR(64) NOT NULL,
  receipt_id VARCHAR(191) NOT NULL,
  status ENUM('PENDING','DELIVERED','FAILED','EXPIRED') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'PENDING',
  provider_error VARCHAR(120) NULL,
  checked_at TIMESTAMP NULL,
  created_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  PRIMARY KEY (id),
  UNIQUE KEY uq_app_push_ticket_receipt (receipt_id),
  KEY idx_app_push_ticket_pending (status,created_at),
  CONSTRAINT fk_app_push_ticket_job FOREIGN KEY (job_id) REFERENCES app_push_delivery_jobs(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  CONSTRAINT fk_app_push_ticket_user FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci;

tables_to_add.reason: Incomplete checkout state, revision and expiry. Not a confirmed reservation or an issued sales offer.
tables_to_add.proposed_definition:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS app_booking_drafts (
  id BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  created_by_user_id INT UNSIGNED NOT NULL,
  created_by_agent_id INT UNSIGNED NULL,
  customer_id INT UNSIGNED NOT NULL,
  agency_id INT UNSIGNED NULL,
  service_code VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL,
  status ENUM('DRAFT','READY','QUOTED','CHECKED_OUT','EXPIRED','ABANDONED') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'DRAFT',
  details JSON NOT NULL,
  revision INT UNSIGNED NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
  quote_snapshot_id BIGINT UNSIGNED NULL,
  reservation_id INT UNSIGNED NULL,
  expires_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
  created_at TIMESTAMP NULL,
  updated_at TIMESTAMP NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (id),
  KEY idx_app_booking_drafts_user_status (created_by_user_id,status),
  KEY idx_app_booking_drafts_customer (customer_id),
  KEY idx_app_booking_drafts_expiry (expires_at,status),
  CONSTRAINT fk_app_booking_drafts_user FOREIGN KEY (created_by_user_id) REFERENCES users(id),
  CONSTRAINT fk_app_booking_drafts_agent FOREIGN KEY (created_by_agent_id) REFERENCES agents(id),
  CONSTRAINT fk_app_booking_drafts_customer FOREIGN KEY (customer_id) REFERENCES customers(id),
  CONSTRAINT fk_app_booking_drafts_agency FOREIGN KEY (agency_id) REFERENCES agencies(id),
  CONSTRAINT fk_app_booking_drafts_reservation FOREIGN KEY (reservation_id) REFERENCES reservations(id)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci;

tables_to_add.reason: Immutable quoted amount and inputs bound to a draft revision and validity time.
tables_to_add.proposed_definition:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS app_quote_snapshots (
  id BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  draft_id BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL,
  draft_revision INT UNSIGNED NOT NULL,
  request_hash CHAR(64) NOT NULL,
  currency CHAR(3) NOT NULL,
  total_amount DECIMAL(12,2) NOT NULL,
  quote_data JSON NOT NULL,
  valid_until TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
  created_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  PRIMARY KEY (id),
  KEY idx_app_quote_draft (draft_id,valid_until),
  CONSTRAINT fk_app_quote_draft FOREIGN KEY (draft_id) REFERENCES app_booking_drafts(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci;

tables_to_add.reason: Prevents duplicate checkout on retries and returns the original response.
tables_to_add.proposed_definition:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS app_idempotency_keys (
  id BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  user_id INT UNSIGNED NOT NULL,
  scope VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL,
  idempotency_key VARCHAR(191) NOT NULL,
  request_hash CHAR(64) NOT NULL,
  response_status INT NOT NULL,
  response_body JSON NOT NULL,
  expires_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
  created_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  PRIMARY KEY (id),
  UNIQUE KEY uq_app_idempotency_user_scope_key (user_id,scope,idempotency_key),
  KEY idx_app_idempotency_expiry (expires_at),
  CONSTRAINT fk_app_idempotency_user FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci;

tables_to_add.reason: Stripe attempt and intent state, provider reference, retry metadata and refund reference. Client reservation_payments owns paid money.
tables_to_add.proposed_definition:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS app_payment_transactions (
  id BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  reservation_id INT UNSIGNED NOT NULL,
  user_id INT UNSIGNED NOT NULL,
  provider VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL,
  provider_reference VARCHAR(191) NULL,
  amount DECIMAL(12,2) NOT NULL,
  currency CHAR(3) NOT NULL,
  status VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL,
  idempotency_key VARCHAR(191) NULL,
  provider_payload JSON NULL,
  refund_reference VARCHAR(191) NULL,
  created_at TIMESTAMP NULL,
  updated_at TIMESTAMP NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (id),
  UNIQUE KEY uq_app_payment_provider_ref (provider,provider_reference),
  KEY idx_app_payment_reservation (reservation_id,status),
  CONSTRAINT fk_app_payment_reservation FOREIGN KEY (reservation_id) REFERENCES reservations(id),
  CONSTRAINT fk_app_payment_user FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES users(id)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci;

tables_to_add.reason: Provider event deduplication and audit so repeated webhooks cannot post payment twice.
tables_to_add.proposed_definition:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS app_payment_webhook_events (
  id BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  provider VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL,
  provider_event_id VARCHAR(191) NOT NULL,
  payload JSON NOT NULL,
  received_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (id),
  UNIQUE KEY uq_app_payment_webhook_event (provider,provider_event_id)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci;

tables_to_add.reason: Individual agent roster, active membership, preferences and notes. customers.agency_id identifies an agency, not a particular agent.
tables_to_add.proposed_definition:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS app_agent_customer_assignments (
  id BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  agent_id INT UNSIGNED NOT NULL,
  customer_id INT UNSIGNED NOT NULL,
  agency_id INT UNSIGNED NOT NULL,
  status ENUM('ACTIVE','INACTIVE') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'ACTIVE',
  preferences JSON NULL,
  notes TEXT NULL,
  assigned_by_user_id INT UNSIGNED NOT NULL,
  assigned_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
  created_at TIMESTAMP NULL,
  updated_at TIMESTAMP NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (id),
  UNIQUE KEY uq_app_agent_customer (agent_id,customer_id),
  KEY idx_app_agent_customer_customer (customer_id,status),
  KEY idx_app_agent_customer_agency (agency_id,status),
  CONSTRAINT fk_app_agent_customer_agent FOREIGN KEY (agent_id) REFERENCES agents(id),
  CONSTRAINT fk_app_agent_customer_customer FOREIGN KEY (customer_id) REFERENCES customers(id),
  CONSTRAINT fk_app_agent_customer_agency FOREIGN KEY (agency_id) REFERENCES agencies(id),
  CONSTRAINT fk_app_agent_customer_assigner FOREIGN KEY (assigned_by_user_id) REFERENCES users(id)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci;

tables_to_add.reason: Pending requested change, prior lifecycle, requested values, approver and resolution. A reservation row stores the accepted booking.
tables_to_add.proposed_definition:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS app_booking_change_requests (
  id BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  reservation_id INT UNSIGNED NOT NULL,
  requested_by_user_id INT UNSIGNED NOT NULL,
  status VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'PENDING',
  previous_lifecycle_status VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL,
  reason TEXT NOT NULL,
  requested_changes JSON NOT NULL,
  resolution_note TEXT NULL,
  resolved_by_user_id INT UNSIGNED NULL,
  resolved_at TIMESTAMP NULL,
  created_at TIMESTAMP NULL,
  updated_at TIMESTAMP NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (id),
  KEY idx_app_change_request_reservation (reservation_id,status),
  CONSTRAINT fk_app_change_request_reservation FOREIGN KEY (reservation_id) REFERENCES reservations(id),
  CONSTRAINT fk_app_change_request_requester FOREIGN KEY (requested_by_user_id) REFERENCES users(id),
  CONSTRAINT fk_app_change_request_resolver FOREIGN KEY (resolved_by_user_id) REFERENCES users(id)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci;

tables_to_add.reason: Pending cancellation and refund approval state, reason, reviewer and resolution; distinct from an already cancelled booking.
tables_to_add.proposed_definition:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS app_booking_cancellation_requests (
  id BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  reservation_id INT UNSIGNED NOT NULL,
  requested_by_user_id INT UNSIGNED NOT NULL,
  status VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'PENDING',
  previous_lifecycle_status VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL,
  reason TEXT NOT NULL,
  resolution_note TEXT NULL,
  resolved_by_user_id INT UNSIGNED NULL,
  resolved_at TIMESTAMP NULL,
  created_at TIMESTAMP NULL,
  updated_at TIMESTAMP NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (id),
  KEY idx_app_cancel_request_reservation (reservation_id,status),
  CONSTRAINT fk_app_cancel_request_reservation FOREIGN KEY (reservation_id) REFERENCES reservations(id),
  CONSTRAINT fk_app_cancel_request_requester FOREIGN KEY (requested_by_user_id) REFERENCES users(id),
  CONSTRAINT fk_app_cancel_request_resolver FOREIGN KEY (resolved_by_user_id) REFERENCES users(id)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci;

tables_to_add.reason: Stable existing conversation ID and open or closed state per reservation. Message content moves to client message tables.
tables_to_add.proposed_definition:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS app_conversations (
  id BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  reservation_id INT UNSIGNED NOT NULL,
  status ENUM('ACTIVE','CLOSED') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'ACTIVE',
  created_at TIMESTAMP NULL,
  updated_at TIMESTAMP NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (id),
  UNIQUE KEY uq_app_conversation_reservation (reservation_id),
  CONSTRAINT fk_app_conversation_reservation FOREIGN KEY (reservation_id) REFERENCES reservations(id)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci;

tables_to_add.reason: Membership, role, join and leave boundaries needed before any message exists. Existing recipients are per-message, not conversation membership.
tables_to_add.proposed_definition:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS app_conversation_participants (
  id BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  conversation_id BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL,
  user_id INT UNSIGNED NOT NULL,
  participant_role VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL,
  joined_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
  left_at TIMESTAMP NULL,
  last_read_at TIMESTAMP NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (id),
  UNIQUE KEY uq_app_conversation_participant (conversation_id,user_id),
  KEY idx_app_conversation_participant_user (user_id,left_at),
  CONSTRAINT fk_app_conversation_participant_conversation FOREIGN KEY (conversation_id) REFERENCES app_conversations(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  CONSTRAINT fk_app_conversation_participant_user FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES users(id)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci;

tables_to_add.reason: Assignment GPS samples with time, heading and speed. A current vehicle location field is not a trip location history.
tables_to_add.proposed_definition:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS app_driver_locations (
  id BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  assignment_id BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL,
  driver_id INT UNSIGNED NOT NULL,
  latitude DECIMAL(10,7) NOT NULL,
  longitude DECIMAL(10,7) NOT NULL,
  heading DECIMAL(6,2) NULL,
  speed DECIMAL(8,2) NULL,
  accuracy DECIMAL(8,2) NULL,
  recorded_at DATETIME NOT NULL,
  created_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  PRIMARY KEY (id),
  KEY idx_app_driver_location_assignment_time (assignment_id,recorded_at),
  KEY idx_app_driver_location_driver_time (driver_id,recorded_at),
  CONSTRAINT fk_app_driver_location_assignment FOREIGN KEY (assignment_id) REFERENCES app_mobile_assignment_ids(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  CONSTRAINT fk_app_driver_location_driver FOREIGN KEY (driver_id) REFERENCES drivers(id)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci;

tables_to_add.reason: Internal chauffeur outlay and reimbursement approval. Restore this existing designed table instead of writing a zero customer cost and hiding the actual amount in another column.
tables_to_add.proposed_definition:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS app_driver_expenses (
  id BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  assignment_id BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL,
  reservation_id INT UNSIGNED NOT NULL,

remaining_if_reported_exactly_true.deployment_ledger: Client DBA should apply reviewed SQL and record it in deployment records. Node migrate script creates app_schema_migrations and historical 001-010 creates unwanted tables; do not run it unchanged.

expand_reported_assignment_allocator.reason: One native reservation_drivers row can hold pickup and drop-off drivers. The existing mobile fields on that row can represent only one public ID and state. Preserve the native row and map each role to its stable ID and independent mobile state here.
expand_reported_assignment_allocator.active_slot_semantics: current_slot=1 identifies the current mapping; historical mappings use NULL. The unique index permits many historical records but only one current mapping per native row and role.
expand_reported_assignment_allocator.migration: Backfill current assignment IDs, native row/role links and old assignment history with collision checks; then retarget location, expense and incident foreign keys. Change assignment reads/writes and history lookups in one backend release.

integration_blockers_requiring_code_and_: A native reservation_drivers row can hold two distinct drivers but only one mobile_assignment_id and mobile_assignment_status. Project role-specific state through the expanded app_mobile_assignment_ids table and preserve old public IDs.

Admin assignment writes pick_up_driver_id/drop_off_driver_id but Chauffeur app assignment view filters mobile_assignment_id IS NOT NULL; map native assignments into stable API IDs and both pickup/dropoff roles.

Admin-created reservation and leg queries are filtered by service_code IS NOT NULL and sequence_no IS NOT NULL in mobile booking details/dashboard and operations assignment; implement native fallbacks.

Build two-way status translation for reservations.status, reservation_details.trip_status_id, reservation_statuses and mobile lifecycle; admin reassignment, cancellation and trip progress must be visible to the app.
Use one availability/booking ledger and compatible locking between admin and mobile before claiming double booking prevention.
Verify native reservation_payments and gateway transaction totals including deferred, retries, refunds and duplicate webhooks.
Client admin must expose review actions for contacts VIP/concierge and new change/cancel requests, plus private files and internal driver expenses.
Check actual live rows and data before ID backfill, especially old app_messages, app_notifications, app_documents, app_vip_requests and app_concierge_requests.

Review scope dependent client tables reservation_comments, refund_vouchers, credit_notes, reservation_deposits and reservation_payment_with_others; add to mobile reuse only when these operations are in the current API/finance contract.

notes: Original client tables and keys are preserved.
Views are additional schema objects, not additional base tables.
Missing driver_status rows and native trip_status rows are added without changing existing IDs; confirmed/completed use a _trip alias when their slug already belongs to a driver status.

production_parity_update.pricing_policy: Client-confirmed BASE_FEE_ONLY_V1: only max(0, base fee minus allocated discount) is taxable; optional extras, collection, excess distance and insurance are untaxed. Native quantities and rate_type configured amounts are retained. PHP recalculation paths require the same rule.
production_parity_update.status_policy: Trip statuses use trip_status, detailed driver events remain separate; chargeable no-show/cancellation never triggers an automatic refund
